commit_scope: The Hati Suci grocery ledger becomes resilient against duplicate entries and lost Sheet receipts. (a) Every draft carries a client-minted entry_key; the server derives the entry id from it, so a re-posted draft returns the entry already made across retries, restarts and races. (b) The Sheet append leaves the phone's request path: the response returns after the graph write and a bounded background task appends on its own 30 s clock, settles a lost answer with one summary read, and always leaves a durable receipt; totals persist the Sheet's own acknowledgements and carry confirmed_at so the page says how old its confirmed balance is. Scope per Urs: fix the mechanism and leave the existing duplicate rows as they are (the 2026-10-16 copies are repaired by hand in production data); no review door ships.
evidence_refs: ROOT CAUSE, grounded 2026-10-24 inside the production API container: the phone's offline queue treated any fetch error or timeout as offline and re-posted the draft on every mount and online event; drafts carried no id, SpendCreate had no idempotency field, and record_spend awaited the Apps Script append (up to 6.5 s) inside the request. Apps Script measured 3–30 s, so the POST outlived the phone's fetch while the entry had already landed. Receipts: _push_to_sheet_status returned unavailable after 6.5 s although the row was written; entries then sat in the sheet but unsynced in the graph until a summary happened to land inside the totals budget.

DEDUPE IS THE PRIMARY KEY, NOT AN INDEX: _entry_id_for_key hashes the client key into the entry id (spend-<sha256[:12]>). A repeated key reads the existing node before any kernel work; a race between two re-posts lands on create_node's IntegrityError, which the private-type path raises as ValueError, caught and answered with the existing entry. No new index, no migration, no window. Verified by test_a_repeated_entry_key_records_one_entry: four posts, one id; a topup key lives in its own lane; a malformed key is 422 before anything is written.

THE MIRROR LEAVES THE REQUEST: _store_entry writes the graph and hands _mirror_entry_in_background to Starlette BackgroundTasks, which runs after the response is sent (deterministically before TestClient returns). The background append uses _SHEET_BACKGROUND_WRITE_TIMEOUT 30 s (httpx attempt and wall clock) instead of the request-path 6.5 s. An unavailable answer triggers one _read_sheet_snapshot([id]); acknowledged → synced, cancelled → cancelled, dark → the existing retry handle (sheet_append_retry_after + yield flag) that /grocery/sheet/resync already honours. Proven by test_the_mirror_append_leaves_the_request_path (response sheet_synced false, node synced afterwards, background timeout observed), test_a_lost_append_answer_is_settled_by_the_sheets_acknowledgement, test_an_unanswered_append_leaves_a_durable_retry_handle.

TOTALS KEEP THE SHEET'S WORD: when summary acknowledges rows the graph still calls unsynced, _persist_snapshot_receipts writes sheet_synced/sheet_cancelled receipts inside the same 13 s budget, best effort, and only when there is something to write (no DB write on the common path). TotalsResponse gains confirmed_at (UTC ISO at the moment the snapshot was read; null when unavailable) and pending_count. Proven by test_totals_record_sheet_acknowledgements_and_say_when_confirmed. The setup doc's sentence that a totals read never mutates either ledger is retuned: it never OFFERS rows to the sheet; it does keep the sheet's own acknowledgement.

PHONE: Draft gains entry_key (newEntryKey → crypto.randomUUID, fallback random hex), minted on Record and persisted in the localStorage queue; withEntryKeys gives an older queued draft a key the first time the queue is read so even a stale queue flushes idempotently. The balance line composes the state copy with confirmationAge(confirmed_at, now) — 'confirmed 3 min ago' / 'terkonfirmasi 3 mnt lalu' — ticking every 30 s. web: tsc clean, vitest passes including the new confirmationAge, newEntryKey, withEntryKeys and page-source claims.

SCOPE: a duplicate-review door (Form grouping policy lowered from BML, GET /grocery/duplicates, POST /grocery/duplicates/resolve through the Sheet cancellation path, a Keep-one card on the phone) was built and proven, then removed before merge on Urs's scope — 'fix 10-16, leave the rest and make resilient against dups'. The existing duplicate rows stay as they are; the 2026-10-16 Pasar copies are repaired by hand in production data by the session that holds that context. The removed work is in this branch's history (1a97bff18) should the door be wanted later.

ENVIRONMENT NOTE: test_generic_graph_access_cannot_bypass_grocery_privacy_or_reconciliation fails on this Mac before and after this change (count route answers 405 where the claim expects 403; /api/graph/nodes/count is native-owned per api/config/native_api.json) — the parent session recorded the same local/CI difference; it was deselected in the local grocery-file runs and is not touched here. CI's default pytest collection is the core suite (api/tests/core_suite.txt), which does not list test_grocery_ledger.py; the grocery claims were run explicitly by file.

deploy_validation.summary: After the merge rolls out: https://app.hati.earth/ answers 200 and its balance line shows the confirmation age; GET /api/grocery/totals carries confirmed_at; a repeated POST with one entry_key creates one entry.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: A repeated POST /api/grocery/spend or /topup with the same entry_key returns the same entry instead of a new one. A record returns before the Sheet append; the append runs after the response on a 30 s clock and leaves a durable receipt (synced, cancelled, or a retry handle), and a later summary acknowledgement is kept by the totals read. Totals carry confirmed_at and pending_count; the phone's balance line says how old its confirmation is.
public_endpoints: GET https://api.coherencycoin.com/api/grocery/totals?token=<member> — confirmed_at and pending_count beside remaining_idr
https://app.hati.earth/ — the ledger with its confirmation age
e2e_validation.notes: The existing duplicate rows in production are left as they are by this change; the 2026-10-16 copies are being repaired by hand in production data.
